decisions.reason: Enabling ETH and USDC wallet-payment selection does not change the mint price, revenue shares, or prize-pool allocation.
The decision concerns selectable wallet-payment currencies and does not alter the separate Transak fiat-payment path.
Payment-currency selection does not change whether tipping is available or any tipping options.
USDC remains an enabled wallet-mint path with the same expected mint behavior; adding ETH as another selectable currency does not modify the USDC flow.
The source decision's effect on this Requirement is already fully represented by the same-message INTRODUCE establishing that ETH payment is enabled.
The wallet-currency selector does not alter embedded-wallet provisioning or reward access for fiat buyers.
Primary-mint wallet currency selection does not change secondary-sale royalties, marketplace controls, or royalty allocation.
The client accepted a mint-page currency selector but did not request corresponding changes to the About page.
The source decision does not require any FAQ wording change and does not supersede the existing fiat-payment explanation.
Offering ETH and USDC as wallet-payment choices does not change SIWE authentication or the paths requiring wallet authentication.
Mint payment-currency selection does not change automatic prize transfer or the winner-wallet destination.
The accepted wallet-payment choices do not change prize eligibility, ticket weighting, or Chainlink VRF winner selection.
